correctness.rationale: The faces are nonattacking rook placements on the 6×6 board omitting all six diagonal squares. Every face is reconstructed by injection of distinct row and column labels; f-vector (30,315,1420,2715,1854,265). Direct sparse modular reductions of ∂4 at primes 1009 and 65521 reproduce rank1557 and all 22 S6×C2 homology character values; the source additionally performs rational Fraction elimination, and lower and upper boundary ranks (29,286,1134,1557,265) yield reduced rational ranks H3=24, H4=32, nothing else. For each diagonal permutation cycle type and side swap, oriented simplex-fixed-face traces and the induced ∂4 image action give independent H3 and H4 characters via Hopf trace. Reproduced character projections have nonnegative integer multiplicities: H3 partitions (4,2) sign-under-swap, (3,1,1,1) even, (2,2,2) odd, dimensions 9+10+5=24; H4 (6) even, (4,1,1) odd, (3,2,1) odd, (2,1,1,1,1) even, dimensions 1+10+16+5=32. This is rational homology, not integral torsion or homotopy.
residual_risks: Full rational image calculation is justified by inspected exact-arithmetic source algorithm; two modular primes alone would not certify rational rank or absence of exceptional-prime torsion.
No statement about integral homology torsion, equivariant homotopy, or an arbitrary-size family is validated.
